text: 💡 Blackberry. The thorny bush with dark berries you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
💡 Hickory Nuts. The tree with compound leaves and hard nuts you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
💡 The giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk — THAT's what A woman, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles was describing. Burdock. It clicks like a key turning.
💡 Learned: PARTY SYSTEM. You can invite people to travel and fight beside you. Ask — in conversation, like a person.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Mountain Lord: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Choir Toad: Break the chorus. The Resonant Croak needs the chorus — every throat in range joins. SHOUT and the note dies mid-croak. The hum needs the choir; scatter the choir. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Highbeam Deer: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Static: Don't walk toward the voice. Resist the lure: don't move toward the crying. Two rounds of refusal and the act breaks — it's a radio, exposed and furious, and it has to re-spool before it rushes. That's your window. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Extended Warranty: Never stand still. The RING is the telegraph — the pitch itself gives no warning. Move two or more tiles from where you stood when it dialed and the call drops. It can only dial a stationary target. Never stand still. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Cliffhanger: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Inspiration: Be three tiles out. The bloom is the timer: two beats of brightening, then white. Be three tiles out when it flares. The ember beat after is safe — walk in and finish it while it glows itself out. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Glasswing Darter: Move when the shadow grows. Watch the shadow, not the bug — when it grows, the dive is coming. MOVE while it falls and it lands on dirt. A missed dive grounds it: that's your window. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — ducks in a row: Break the line. The line is one animal, but only while it's whole. Strike a duck that ISN'T the head and the line splits — both halves hunt on their own and the formation dies. Break the line, then thin the pieces. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Union Rep: Kill the rep first. It does not fight, it ORGANIZES — kill the rep before WALKOUT or the stomp lands as one. First blood on the rep, every time. Every ally it rallies hits +3 harder. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Loud Beast: Leave the marked square. The mark is generous — two full beats to leave the square. When it dips to transmit it's at melee height and takes +50%: that's the only window. Leave the square, then punish the dip. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sunback: Fight from its shadow side. When it arches, move to its SHADOW side — between it and the sun — and don't stand still. 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nightlight: Never wade in. The glow is a mouth — it waits for you to come close. Never wade in. Strike the light from two squares out and it's just a fish with a lamp. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Moderator: Wait — silence is a verb it can't moderate. It mutes the verb you lean on — strike or move, whichever you use more. But silence is a verb the algorithm cannot moderate: WAIT and its attention slides off your habits. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sunbasker: Never let it finish basking. Its scales go molten gold as it charges — hit it while it basks and the charge dies unspent — a stun, a shout, a thrown rock, anything that breaks its focus. Interruptible: the bask is a ritual, and rituals need quiet. Don't let it finish.
